historical_domain_slug_normalization.condition: a matching finalized domain directory exists

canonical_published_form.feature_package: Feature Handoff Package v1.0 JSON schemas under handoff/schemas

conflict_rules: Every present domain identity alias must equal the catalog domain.
Every present count alias must be an integer equal to the exact extracted population.
A sibling finalization manifest may supply count evidence only when the inventory itself has no recognized count.
Any manifest population used as evidence must equal the inventory population exactly and in order.
List and mapping population shapes preserve their source order.
No compatibility rule may change a feature_id or ignore a divergence.
deprecation_policy: Historical read aliases remain accepted for model 1.0 because they exist in authoritative inventories. New handoff catalogs publish only their schema-defined canonical fields. Removal requires a versioned migration and repository-wide evidence.
transferred_controls: authoritative inventory identity, count and order
self_tests: A-K cover completeness, missing/orphan packages, collisions, altered pilot, list and mapping inventories, agreeing and conflicting aliases, missing evidence, and reversible historical slug normalization.
